stories.title: Mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case
stories.summary: A judge declared a mistrial in the case of Lindsay Clancy, charged with murdering her three children, after the jury deadlocked 11-1. The lone holdout, the only juror voting to convict, became the story of the day. TMZ's breaking post got 32K likes and quotes of it another 126K, and a clip of the holdout leaving court got 144K.
